Hi Maya — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answers up front, details below:

Yes — mixed deployments are supported and can be billed on a single invoice.
Proration for seat tier swaps is handled pro-rata for the remainder of the billing period; we can show an estimated delta before you commit.
We can offer a bundled discount (one-time credit + reduced unit rate) if you commit to the performance tier for the generation workload and add Optimize credits for 12 months.

Details:
- Mixed routing: you can pin specific routes to different model/tier combos. This is a routing policy on the Console. Traffic and token usage will be aggregated on billing, but unit rates apply per route's tier.
- Proration math: we charge the time-weighted difference. Example (for transparency): if a seat moves from Compact ($0.015/token) to Performance ($0.035/token) halfway through a 30-day cycle, you'll be charged the difference for the remaining 15 days on the higher rate. We'll surface this as a single debit on the next invoice.
- Bundling/discount: proposed commercial: 12-month term, 15% applied to performance-tier generation tokens, plus a one-time $10k Optimize credit (applied monthly as $833). This assumes 6 committed seats and a minimum monthly token baseline (we can make this explicit).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Aditya will draft a short amendment with the credit & proration language.
2) We'll provide a pro-forma showing the month-by-month impact in your account.
3) Quick 30-min call early next week to align stakeholders and finalize signatures.

Looping in Aditya to prepare the amendment.

Cheers,

Hi Maya and procurement team — Aditya here (commercial ops). Quick replies to your clarifications and the amendment draft plan below.

1) Discount scope: the 15% performance-tier discount applies to the committed baseline monthly volume for the performance routes. Incremental usage above that baseline reverts to list rate. We can define the baseline in the amendment.

2) Downgrade/penalty: There is no early termination penalty for reassigning seats between tiers, provided the overall committed spend for the term is preserved. If the change reduces your committed spend below agreed minimums, we'd re-evaluate the credit schedule — standard commercial protection. The simple clause you proposed is acceptable; we'll add a short exception for reductions that trigger minimums.

3) Optimize credit usage: the $10k Optimize credit is fungible across KV caching, batching policy tuning, and quantization recommendations delivered by our Optimize team. It cannot be redeemed for professional services outside of the Optimize scope (e.g., custom model engineering).

Amendment & pro-forma: attached is a first-pass amendment (redwood_amendment_draft.docx) with: credit schedule, proration language, baseline definition, and a sample proration table. I'll also attach a month-by-month pro-forma PDF in the follow-up with numbers specific to your last 3 months of usage.

If that all sounds good, let's book a 30-min call tomorrow at 11am PT to finalize. If procurement prefers, we can also accept redlines directly on the doc.

Thanks —
